releaseNotes: Arabic Rescue Search keeps the completed Smart Search index and never starts a full rebuild automatically. When an Arabic Search Content query has no saved match, Smart Life checks only likely OCR-dependent files: scanned PDFs first, then document-like images with existing OCR text or high-probability document paths. The corrected PaddleOCR Arabic model runs on a small bounded batch, fresh OCR text is merged into the existing SQLite row so English and numbers are preserved, and separate path/mtime/size repair checkpoints ensure the same files are not repeated. A search attempt repairs at most 24 visual files and stops early when matches are found; if needed, repeating the same Arabic search continues from saved repair progress. Existing Turbo Deep OCR checkpoints, Search by Name, English/number search, Pause/Resume, Connect to PC, Transfer Status, reminders, sounds, and all previous Smart Life behavior are preserved.
